note: Asked before any new brochure is drafted. `brochure.py intake <file>` lists the ones still unanswered. Keys point into the programme file.

questions.question: What is the exact programme name as it should appear on the cover?
questions.example: Advanced Certificate in GHG & Net-Zero Practitioner Programme

questions.question: Which edition or year is this brochure for?
What level is it (foundation, practitioner, advanced) and what does a graduate move from and to?
Which existing ESGPro programme is closest, and what is the one difference a buyer must understand?
questions.example: Same four-week core as GHG & SBTi; adds LCA integration

questions.question: Who is it for, and who is it explicitly not for?
questions.example: EHS, quality, finance, audit or ESG professionals asked for carbon numbers

questions.question: What is the delivery format (live, online, weekends, recordings)?
What weekly time commitment should a participant plan for?
Is the cohort capped? At how many places?
What is the next cohort start date, or the approved wording if it is not fixed yet?
List every module or week: title, what is taught (3 points) and the artefact the participant builds.
questions.example: Week 1 Measure: boundary, Scope 1 & 2 ... Builds: Scope 1 & 2 inventory

questions.question: What credential is awarded, by whom, and on what completion criteria? Are any external exams included or excluded?
questions.example: Certification included; external exams not included

questions.question: What is the fee, in which currency, and is it inclusive of taxes? Any instalments, booking amount, team or in-house rates?
questions.example: ₹74,990, one payment; teams 3+ seats on application

questions.question: What exactly does the fee cover, and what is charged separately?
questions.example: All live sessions, reviewed submissions, toolkit and certification

questions.question: What is the live enrolment or payment URL for the QR code? (Open it and confirm it is not a draft or copy page.)
Which testimonials should appear (ids from facts.json), and do we have permission and a photo for each?
questions.example: alankrita, sundar, pradeep + murali, dhairya, indrani

questions.question: Have any shared facts changed since the last brochure (participants trained, company transformations, mentor bio, client names)? Update facts.json, never the programme file.
Is the image manifest current: logo, mentor portrait(s) and one unique photo per testimonial? Any new photos to add?
Is there a refund window or guarantee, and its exact conditions?
questions.example: Week-one guarantee: full refund if requested before week two
